thread:
Alice B: Heads up — noticed traffic from a client app failing model calls after last night's RBAC refactor. 401s for embeddings routes but chat still works.
Ben R: Ugh. Which token scopes are showing up in the logs?
Alice B: Example from the audit log: `Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-xxxxx scopes=[routes:chat:model:read]` but request was to `/v1/embeddings` and got scope-denied.
Carol M: That sounds like scope translation mismatch. We recently changed the canonical scope names to include per-model prefixes. Might be a mapping regression on token-lookup.
Dmitri K: IIRC the token cache stores scope tags from KMS metadata during rotation. If a key rewrap happened, stale cache entries could retain old allowlists.
Alice B: KMS shows a rewrap at 03:12 UTC. `kms-bot: rewrap success key=k-77 rewrap_ts=1708504800` in audit.
kms-bot: Rewrap complete for key=k-77. Metadata: {tag:v2-policy}.
Ben R: So timeline: RBAC refactor deployed 02:50, KMS rewrap at 03:12, and failures start ~03:20. Looks like the cache invalidation didn't pick up the new tag -> tokens interpreted under legacy scope model.
Carol M: That would mean embeddings calls are being allowed only if token had embeddings-specific scope. Clients with older token format might be interpreted as chat-only and thus 401.
Dmitri K: Quick mitigation: enable a temporary per-route fallback that accepts either `routes:chat:model:read` OR `routes:embeddings:model:read` for the next 30m while we purge caches. I'll open a canary.
Alice B: Please also revoke any tokens that were rewrapped incorrectly? Risk of broader access until cache fixed.
Ben R: I'll push a cache purge to Redis and add a TTL bump so all tokens re-query KMS metadata. Doing now.
Carol M: Rolling back the RBAC mapping change is a risk for stability, prefer cache purge + fallback. If that fails, we can rollback.
Dmitri K: Cache purge done. Confirming 200->500 tokens refreshed.
Alice B: After purge, a few clients still 401. Any pattern?
Ben R: Looks like long-lived service tokens are still hitting an old local LRU on the inference nodes. Pushing hot-reload to nodes to clear LRU.
Dmitri K: Hot-reload started.
kms-bot: Node hot-reload completed on pool=inf-*-usw2.
Carol M: Tests now show embeddings routes responding normally for the affected client.
Alice B: OK. Action items: 1) Ben - add deterministic cache invalidation hook on KMS rewraps (ETA EOD). 2) Dmitri - add node LRU eviction on rekey events (ETA tomorrow AM). 3) Carol - add regression test that simulates per-route scope translation across rotations (ETA this sprint). 4) Security - rotate any tokens that had ambiguous scope tags (Alice/Ben).
Ben R: I'll also add a short-term metric: percent of requests denied with scope-mismatch per route.
Alice B: Filing incident ticket and PR references in comments. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
